ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted against a thin low-intensity black border along the trailing edge and localized dark focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge. Several discrete, high-contrast black circular blobs are distributed across the white ventral surface, most notably a cluster of three in the lower-central region and four scattered across the right lobe. Diffuse, low-contrast yellowish-brown pigmentation is mapped to the lower-central and mid-lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch exhibits a V-shaped geometry with a sharp vertex angle estimated at 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the trailing edge. Serrations on the right lobe exhibit higher pixel-amplitude (peaks) compared to the left lobe. The topography is characterized by irregular spacing between sharp peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge contours follow a mathematical concave curve sweeping from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, circular dark pixel clusters on the right lobe and central area, suggesting focal scarring or pigmentation markers.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark curvilinear pixel disruptions (rake marks) mapped horizontally across the right lobe and diagonally on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular textural anomalies and yellowish-brown clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization or localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive pair of small, dark circular markers positioned symmetrically near the peduncle junction in the lower-center of the fluke surface.
